concerns.text: FR-005 requires the regression to predict the Universal Collapse Intensity (FR-036), but T007 builds regression_input.parquet with 'target inflection_step' (per contracts/regression_input.schema.yaml). No task regresses on the Universal Collapse Intensity, so FR-005's specified target has no covering task. (Plan Phase 7 says 'annotated collapse intensity' — a third inconsistent target; the tasks must pick and implement the spec-mandated one or record an amendment.)

concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs spec.md:US-3 Independent Test
concerns.text: US-3's independent test requires 'a model-agnostic SHAP analysis must be performed to confirm the form of interaction.' No task in tasks.md performs or reports SHAP (the plan lists `shap` as a dependency and its constitution check mentions it, but no task implements it). The SHAP deliverable has no covering task.

FR-033 requires that 'Regression predictions will be compared against this ground-truth set to compute an out-of-sample R².' T006 only computes precision/recall (SC-009); no task computes the out-of-sample R² of regression predictions against the 500 expert-labeled curves. That half of FR-033 is uncovered.

SC-004 measures completion of the stress-test pipeline 'within 48 hours for a pilot run and 72 hours for the full dataset.' T010 runs the full pipeline but no task records or checks wall-time against these budgets, so SC-004 has no measurement task.

FR-051 specifies cosine similarity ≥ 0.80 'between vectors ... across all ASR models' (pairwise between models), while T008 computes 'cosine similarity between each model's critical interaction vector and the cross-model mean.' The task covers a different (though related) quantity; align the task's measured similarity with the FR-051 definition or document the equivalence.
